note: The same defect as 004 in a second place. codegen._alloc refuses an array this large -- correctly -- and formats the refusal with the length interpolated into an f-string, which is a decimal conversion of a 20,000-bit integer, which CPython caps at 4300 digits. The ValueError replaces the CodegenError. Kept as its own vector because each site is separately fixable and a partial fix must not look like a whole one; the class is 'RL diagnostics interpolate an unbounded integer into their own message'.
signature: ValueError in codegen._alloc: Exceeds the limit (N digits) for integer string conversion;
